ghj-ghj:lever:8d633e48-2f74-4671-9cab-b1.title: Tax Manager
ghj-ghj:lever:8d633e48-2f74-4671-9cab-b1.description: WHY we get up in the morning At GHJ we help our people and clients pursue their passions, build thriving businesses, and create a better future. WHAT we believe We believe that collaboration is the foundation for success. We work as a business advocate for our clients – providing personalized service and building long-term relationships to help position our clients for the future. HOW we succeed We are deeply committed to our core values of Bright Minds, Brave Hearts and Bold Actions and incorporate them into every aspect of our business. By living these values, we are able to meet our strategic objectives of Remaining Fiercely Independent (financial success), Meeting client demands/needs (client success), Reinforcing and expanding cultural distinction (people success). Summary of Role: The Tax Manager is responsible for the efficient, accurate, complete, and timely preparation of all clients’ tax returns whether prepared personally or by supervision of others. Advanced technical skills in a variety of tax and accounting areas, along with well-developed and applied management and supervisory skills are required. The Tax Manager may have input on any tax issue presented. This particular position is looking for someone who has extensive experience with partnerships and S Corporation tax filings (1065s and 1120S), as well as some experience with individual/trust tax filings (1040s and 1041s).
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, or related equivalent, as well as CPA certification.
5+ years of experience om tax at a public accounting firm or equivalent.
Masters of Science degree in Taxation or a J.D. highly preferred for Tax Management Position.
Minimum of 40 hours of continuing education is required each year to maintain and develop technical and business skills, as well as to maintain license requirements.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:39fb7009-d1d6-.title: Sr People Ops Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:39fb7009-d1d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr People Ops Coordinator based in United States. This role is centered on delivering an exceptional employee experience across the full people lifecycle. You will serve as a trusted escalation point for employees and managers, resolving complex HR questions with accuracy, empathy, and strong follow-through. The position sits within a collaborative People Operations environment, partnering closely with Benefits, Payroll, and People Business Partner teams. You will manage sensitive cases involving leave, payroll, unemployment claims, employee data, onboarding, and other people-related processes. The role also offers opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data quality, and contribute to efficient and scalable HR operations. Success requires excellent organization, discretion, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This is an ideal opportunity for an HR professional who takes ownership of employee needs and enjoys resolving issues from start to finish. Serve as a Level 2/3 escalation point for complex employee questions and cases, ensuring timely, accurate, and employee-focused resolutions. Partner with Benefits specialists on leave of absence cases, serving as a liaison between employees, managers, and Benefits teams. Support managers and Payroll with timely and accurate timecard completion, investigating and resolving discrepancies as needed. Partner with Benefits teams to support annual and ongoing dependent verification activities in accordance with established guidelines. Manage unemployment claims from filing through resolution, coordinating documentation, responses, and follow-up with appropriate stakeholders. Partner with Payroll and ADP to resolve manager inquiries and support accurate timekeeping processes. Own People team vendor administration in Coupa, including vendor onboarding, invoice and purchase order processing, and maintaining accurate vendor records. Support new employees during their first week by answering questions, assisting with required documentation, and auditing U.S.-based new hire data. Champion an employee-first, customer-centric approach by taking ownership of requests through full resolution. Monitor HR audit reports and systems to identify and correct employee data discrepancies. Maintain People Operations documentation, records, and administrative processes. Support the drafting, tracking, and administration of workforce management letter agreements. Identify and implement improvements to People Operations processes, including documentation and RACI development. Collaborate with internal governance, risk, and compliance teams to support monthly HITRUST audit requirements. Support onboarding activities and ensure required new hire documentation is completed accurately and on time. Provide operational support throughout the employee lifecycle, from onboarding through offboarding. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 1–2 years of HR experience, with practical knowledge of leave of absence processes, ADA accommodations, payroll, and timecard procedures. Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, and unemployment claims processes. Strong proficiency with HRIS platforms and Microsoft Office Suite. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple cases, priorities, and competing deadlines. Exceptional customer service skills and a genuine commitment to creating positive employee experiences. Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to take complex requests from initial inquiry through resolution. Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8cbb3919-7b1e-.title: Project Architect / Internal Design - EV Construction
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8cbb3919-7b1e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Architect / Internal Design - EV Construction based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to shape the design of facilities supporting the rapidly growing electric vehicle ecosystem. You’ll contribute to architectural design, BIM coordination, and documentation across a portfolio of EV operations facilities. The position combines technical architectural expertise with advanced Revit and BIM capabilities to create scalable, efficient, and compliant solutions. You’ll work across multiple concurrent projects, balancing design quality, consistency, and delivery requirements. Your work will help establish repeatable prototypes, standards, and workflows that improve efficiency across future projects. This is an ideal environment for an architect who enjoys technically complex work, collaboration, and process improvement. Develop architectural drawing packages for multiple concurrent EV facility projects, including site plans, floor plans, elevations, sections, details, and other construction documentation. Produce site layouts, feasibility studies, and early-stage design concepts for new and existing EV operations facilities. Research applicable building and construction codes across multiple jurisdictions and prepare site-specific code analyses. Coordinate architectural layouts with project requirements, owner standards, internal design criteria, and other project constraints. Maintain consistency and quality across a portfolio of prototype-based facilities and incorporate client feedback through design reviews. Create and maintain accurate Revit models throughout the design process, supporting coordinated and reliable BIM deliverables. Perform BIM model quality reviews, including audits, cleanup, organization, and data integrity checks. Develop and maintain BIM standards, templates, families, shared parameters, project documentation, and other reusable resources. Support model organization and file management while promoting consistent documentation practices across projects. Contribute to standardized prototype documents and identify opportunities to improve efficiency across recurring facility types. Collaborate with project teams and stakeholders to coordinate design information and maintain alignment between architectural, BIM, and project requirements. Manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards for accuracy, organization, and communication. Adhere to applicable internal controls and SOX-related responsibilities where required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. Licensed Architect or actively pursuing professional licensure. 6+ years of relevant architectural experience. Advanced proficiency with Autodesk Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Bluebeam. Demonstrated experience producing schematic design and design development documentation. Strong experience with BIM model management, quality control, and documentation standards. Strong understanding of construction codes and the ability to research, interpret, and apply applicable requirements across different jurisdictions. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality. Excellent organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to design documentation and model management. Experience with EV, automotive, industrial, mission-critical, or prototype facility design is preferred. Familiarity with sustainability principles and energy-efficient design strategies is a plus. Experience with Google Workspace and Miro is preferred. Ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, clients, and other stakeholders while working independently when required. Benefits: Annual

southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5f366ad.title: Founding GTM Lead
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5f366ad.description: About Centari At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. The Role We're hiring a Founding GTM Lead to build Centari's growth engine. You'll sell to the world's leading law firms alongside the CEO, and help us expand into new enterprise verticals. This is a rare early role for someone who wants to define how an AI-native company sells and grows, with a GTM team they'll help build. What You'll Own - Revenue. You source and close six-figure engagements with leading firms, working next to the CEO from your first week. - Pipeline. You own how Centari generates demand, from positioning and messaging to campaigns, events, and outreach, leveraging the resources you need to make it work. - An AI-native GTM engine. You build the systems that let a small team accomplish what used to take a large one, so our motion scales non-linearly. - Dealflow from partnerships. Our channel and integration partners open doors, and you'll ensure we follow through to closing. - The GTM function itself. You'll define how Centari sells, and there's room for the right person to build and lead a team around this function. What You Bring - You've structured and closed complex, six or seven-figure deals with sophisticated buyers: law firm partners, fund principals, or enterprise C-suite executives. Or you've sat in the buyer's seat on deals like these, and you're ready to take on the challenge of being on the other side of the table. - You have the knowledge, communication style, and executive presence to earn a sophisticated buyer's respect and hold your own in the room. - You're fluent with AI as a force multiplier. You reach for LLMs and automation to do the work of a larger team, and you're excited to build that into how a company sells. - A background where you've sold or built relationships with the C-suite at large enterprises (law firms, investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or similar). - Nice to have: you've generated demand and closed deals at an early-stage company, without an established category or a machine behind you. What We Offer - Competitive salary and meaningful equity - Comprehensive health coverage (Centari covers 100% of employee premiums) - Dental and vision (Centari covers 75% of employee premiums) - 401(k) with employer match up to 4% - Lunch covered for in-office team - Flexible PTO

southparkcommons-pillar-space:ashbyhq:f9.description: We're a stealth team building space hardware at the edge of what's currently possible — high-stakes, flight-grade systems where the engineering bar is unforgiving and the upside is enormous. While we can’t share full details yet, our founding and early engineering team includes talent from SpaceX, Northrop Grumman, and Starpath, the group includes people who've pulled off feats almost no one else on Earth has. thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - Adult Gastroenterology Associates (AGA) - powered by GI Alliance. As a member of GI Alliance (GIA), AGA is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician led. This partnership empowers AGA to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging GI Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Lifestyle: Tulsa has a vibrant cultural scene with many attractions Many parks and green spaces Wide range of outdoor activities Strong sense of community Practice Model: Great Work/Life Balance Equal Call with the Physicians at the Practice Protected salary with bonus potential for first 2 years 3rd year partnership track with ASC ownership buy-in potential, additional ancillary income #LI-JC1 Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . The Specialty Alliance Corporate Headquarters, 550 Reserve St., Suite 550, Southlake, TX 76092, USA The Specialty Alliance | GI Alliance | Urology Alliance
